turnover.label: idle-handoff-graph-baseline-after-l4
turnover.caveat: All intervals use the same coordinator clock and include L4 recording overhead. They are not cross-worker idle intervals or isolated L0 operation costs. V6 adds claim records; v5/v6 absolute intervals are not directly comparable. Separate component medians are not additive.

handoffs.label: l3-ordinary-pool-graph-baseline
handoffs.caveat: L3 phase boundaries are instrumented. Negative pieces indicate overlapping early publication. Resolve end is not the time at which every dependent became ready.
